note: Speech attributed to Jesus in the Gospel of John, verse-keyed. confidence != high, or a non-empty note, flags a contested attribution or text.

sayings.text: What are you looking for?
sayings.scene: to Andrew and another disciple of John, near Bethany beyond the Jordan

sayings.text: Come, and see.
sayings.scene: to Andrew and another disciple of John, near Bethany beyond the Jordan

sayings.text: You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter, brought by Andrew

sayings.text: Follow me.
sayings.scene: to Philip in Galilee

sayings.text: Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!
sayings.scene: to Nathanael as he came to him

sayings.text: Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.
sayings.scene: to Nathanael as he came to him

sayings.text: Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!
sayings.scene: to Nathanael as he came to him

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.
sayings.scene: to Nathanael, with the disciples present

sayings.text: Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.
sayings.scene: to his mother at the wedding in Cana

sayings.text: Fill the water pots with water.
sayings.scene: to the servants at the wedding in Cana

sayings.text: Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.
sayings.scene: to the servants at the wedding in Cana

sayings.text: Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!
sayings.scene: to those selling doves in the temple

sayings.text: Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
sayings.scene: to the Jews demanding a sign in the temple

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night

sayings.text: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.
sayings.scene: to Nicodemus, at night
sayings.note: Many editions print this as the evangelist's commentary; others print it in red.

sayings.text: Give me a drink.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: Go, call your husband, and come here.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: I am he, the one who speaks to you.
sayings.scene: to the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well

sayings.text: I have food to eat that you don’t know about.
sayings.scene: to his disciples at Jacob's well

sayings.text: My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.
sayings.scene: to his disciples at Jacob's well

sayings.text: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest?’ Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
sayings.scene: to his disciples at Jacob's well

sayings.text: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
sayings.scene: to his disciples at Jacob's well

sayings.text: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
sayings.scene: to his disciples at Jacob's well

sayings.text: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.
sayings.scene: to his disciples at Jacob's well

sayings.text: Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.
sayings.scene: to the nobleman at Cana

sayings.text: Go your way. Your son lives.
sayings.scene: to the nobleman at Cana

sayings.text: Do you want to be made well?
sayings.scene: to the paralyzed man at the pool of Bethesda

sayings.text: Arise, take up your mat, and walk.
sayings.scene: to the paralyzed man at the pool of Bethesda

sayings.text: Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.
sayings.scene: to the healed man in the temple

sayings.text: My Father is still working, so I am working, too.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who persecuted him for healing on the Sabbath

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: You don’t have his word living in you; because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: I don’t receive glory from men.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?
sayings.scene: to the Jews who opposed him in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?
sayings.scene: to Philip before feeding the crowd on the mountain

sayings.text: Have the people sit down.
sayings.scene: to the crowd on the mountain before the feeding

sayings.text: Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.
sayings.scene: to his disciples after feeding the five thousand

sayings.text: It is I. Don’t be afraid.
sayings.scene: to his disciples in the boat on the sea

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.
sayings.scene: to the crowd at Capernaum

sayings.text: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.
sayings.scene: to the crowd at Capernaum

sayings.text: This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.
sayings.scene: to the crowd at Capernaum

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
sayings.scene: to the crowd at Capernaum

sayings.text: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.
sayings.scene: to the crowd at Capernaum

sayings.text: I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.
sayings.scene: to the crowd at Capernaum

sayings.text: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: Don’t murmur among yourselves.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: I am the bread of life.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: Does this cause you to stumble?
sayings.scene: to his murmuring disciples in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
sayings.scene: to his murmuring disciples in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
sayings.scene: to his murmuring disciples in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: But there are some of you who don’t believe.
sayings.scene: to his murmuring disciples in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.
sayings.scene: to his murmuring disciples in the Capernaum synagogue

sayings.text: You don’t also want to go away, do you?
sayings.scene: to the Twelve at Capernaum

sayings.text: Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?
sayings.scene: to the Twelve at Capernaum

sayings.text: My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
sayings.scene: to his brothers before the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
sayings.scene: to his brothers before the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.
sayings.scene: to his brothers before the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
sayings.scene: crying out in the temple, teaching at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.
sayings.scene: crying out in the temple, teaching at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
sayings.scene: to the crowd in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: You will seek me, and won’t find me; and where I am, you can’t come.
sayings.scene: to the crowd in the temple at the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
sayings.scene: crying out on the last day of the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.
sayings.scene: crying out on the last day of the Feast of Booths

sayings.text: He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.
sayings.scene: to the scribes and Pharisees testing him with the woman taken in adultery
sayings.note: This passage (7:53-8:11) is absent from the earliest manuscripts; most Bibles print it, usually in brackets.

sayings.text: Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?
sayings.scene: to the woman taken in adultery, in the middle of the temple court
sayings.note: This passage (7:53-8:11) is absent from the earliest manuscripts; most Bibles print it, usually in brackets.

sayings.text: Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.
sayings.scene: to the woman taken in adultery
sayings.note: This passage (7:53-8:11) is absent from the earliest manuscripts; most Bibles print it, usually in brackets.

sayings.text: I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple

sayings.text: When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple treasury

sayings.text: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in the temple treasury

sayings.text: If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who had believed him, in the temple

sayings.text: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who had believed him, in the temple

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed Abraham as father

sayings.text: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed Abraham as father

sayings.text: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed Abraham as father

sayings.text: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed Abraham as father

sayings.text: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed Abraham as father

sayings.text: If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed Abraham as father

sayings.text: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed Abraham as father

sayings.text: You do the works of your father.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed God as their father

sayings.text: If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed God as their father

sayings.text: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed God as their father

sayings.text: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed God as their father

sayings.text: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed God as their father

sayings.text: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed God as their father

sayings.text: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who claimed God as their father

sayings.text: I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who called him a Samaritan and demon-possessed

sayings.text: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who called him a Samaritan and demon-possessed

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who called him a Samaritan and demon-possessed

sayings.text: If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple

sayings.text: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple

sayings.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in the temple

sayings.text: Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, seeing the man blind from birth

sayings.text: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, seeing the man blind from birth

sayings.text: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, seeing the man blind from birth

sayings.text: Go, wash in the pool of Siloam
sayings.scene: to the man born blind, sending him to wash

sayings.text: Do you believe in the Son of God?
sayings.scene: to the man born blind, after he was thrown out

sayings.text: You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.
sayings.scene: to the man born blind, after he was thrown out

sayings.text: I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.
sayings.scene: to the man born blind and the Pharisees with him

sayings.text: If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees who were with him

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn’t care for the sheep.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.
sayings.scene: to the Pharisees in Jerusalem, after the healing of the blind man

sayings.text: I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in Solomon's porch at the Feast of Dedication

sayings.text: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in Solomon's porch at the Feast of Dedication

sayings.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in Solomon's porch at the Feast of Dedication

sayings.text: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in Solomon's porch at the Feast of Dedication

sayings.text: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in Solomon's porch at the Feast of Dedication

sayings.text: I and the Father are one.
sayings.scene: to the Jews in Solomon's porch at the Feast of Dedication

sayings.text: I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?
sayings.scene: to the Jews in Solomon's porch at the Feast of Dedication

sayings.text: Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’
sayings.scene: to the Jews who accused him of blasphemy

sayings.text: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
sayings.scene: to the Jews who accused him of blasphemy

sayings.text: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God?’
sayings.scene: to the Jews who accused him of blasphemy

sayings.text: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who accused him of blasphemy

sayings.text: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.
sayings.scene: to the Jews who accused him of blasphemy

sayings.text: This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.
sayings.scene: on hearing that Lazarus was sick, to those who brought word

sayings.text: Let’s go into Judea again.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, two days after hearing of Lazarus

sayings.text: Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, as they set out for Judea

sayings.text: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, about Lazarus

sayings.text: Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, about Lazarus

sayings.text: Lazarus is dead.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, about Lazarus

sayings.text: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.
sayings.scene: to his disciples, about Lazarus

sayings.text: Your brother will rise again.
sayings.scene: to Martha outside Bethany

sayings.text: I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
sayings.scene: to Martha outside Bethany

sayings.text: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?
sayings.scene: to Martha outside Bethany

sayings.text: Where have you laid him?
sayings.scene: at the tomb, to those with him

sayings.text: Take away the stone.
sayings.scene: at the tomb of Lazarus, to those standing there

sayings.text: Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?
sayings.scene: to Martha at the tomb

sayings.text: Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
sayings.scene: praying to the Father at the tomb of Lazarus

sayings.text: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.
sayings.scene: praying to the Father at the tomb of Lazarus

sayings.text: Lazarus, come out!
sayings.scene: calling with a loud voice at the tomb

sayings.text: Free him, and let him go.
sayings.scene: to those standing at the tomb

sayings.text: Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
sayings.scene: at Bethany, defending Mary against Judas's complaint

sayings.text: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.
sayings.scene: at Bethany, continuing to Judas

sayings.text: The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
sayings.scene: to Andrew and Philip, before the crowd in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
sayings.scene: to Andrew, Philip and the crowd, on his hour

sayings.text: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
sayings.scene: to Andrew, Philip and the crowd, on loving one's life

sayings.text: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
sayings.scene: to Andrew, Philip and the crowd, on serving him

sayings.text: Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I came to this time.
sayings.scene: praying aloud before the crowd in Jerusalem

sayings.text: Father, glorify your name!
sayings.scene: praying aloud before the crowd in Jerusalem

sayings.text: This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
sayings.scene: to the crowd about the voice from heaven

sayings.text: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
sayings.scene: to the crowd about the judgment of this world

sayings.text: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.
sayings.scene: to the crowd, on being lifted up

sayings.text: Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
sayings.scene: to the crowd in Jerusalem, on walking in the light

sayings.text: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.
sayings.scene: to the crowd, on becoming children of light

sayings.text: Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
sayings.scene: crying out in Jerusalem, final public appeal

sayings.text: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
sayings.scene: crying out in Jerusalem, on seeing the Father

sayings.text: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
sayings.scene: crying out in Jerusalem, on coming as light

sayings.text: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
sayings.scene: crying out in Jerusalem, on not judging

sayings.text: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
sayings.scene: crying out in Jerusalem, on the word that judges

sayings.text: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
sayings.scene: crying out in Jerusalem, on the Father's commandment

sayings.text: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.
sayings.scene: crying out in Jerusalem, on eternal life

sayings.text: You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter at the foot washing

sayings.text: If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter at the foot washing

sayings.text: Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter at the foot washing

sayings.text: You are not all clean.
sayings.scene: narrator's report of his word at the foot washing

sayings.text: Do you know what I have done to you?
sayings.scene: to the disciples after washing their feet

sayings.text: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
sayings.scene: to the disciples after washing their feet

sayings.text: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
sayings.scene: to the disciples after washing their feet

sayings.text: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples after washing their feet

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
sayings.scene: to the disciples after washing their feet

sayings.text: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
sayings.scene: to the disciples after washing their feet

sayings.text: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on Scripture being fulfilled

sayings.text: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on telling them beforehand

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on receiving the one he sends

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples at supper, announcing the betrayal

sayings.text: It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.
sayings.scene: to the beloved disciple at supper, identifying the betrayer

sayings.text: What you do, do quickly.
sayings.scene: to Judas at supper

sayings.text: Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
sayings.scene: to the disciples after Judas went out

sayings.text: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
sayings.scene: to the disciples after Judas went out

sayings.text: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, as little children

sayings.text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the new commandment

sayings.text: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on being known by love

sayings.text: Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter at supper

sayings.text: Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter, foretelling his denial

sayings.text: Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples in the upper room

sayings.text: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples in the upper room

sayings.text: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
sayings.scene: to the disciples in the upper room

sayings.text: Where I go, you know, and you know the way.
sayings.scene: to the disciples in the upper room

sayings.text: I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
sayings.scene: to Thomas in the upper room

sayings.text: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.
sayings.scene: to Thomas in the upper room

sayings.text: Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
sayings.scene: to Philip in the upper room

sayings.text: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
sayings.scene: to Philip and the disciples

sayings.text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
sayings.scene: to Philip and the disciples

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on greater works

sayings.text: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on asking in his name

sayings.text: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on asking in his name

sayings.text: If you love me, keep my commandments.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on keeping his commandments

sayings.text: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,—
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Counselor

sayings.text: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Spirit of truth

sayings.text: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on not leaving them orphans

sayings.text: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on seeing him again

sayings.text: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on that day

sayings.text: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on loving him

sayings.text: If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.
sayings.scene: to Judas (not Iscariot) and the disciples

sayings.text: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
sayings.scene: to Judas (not Iscariot) and the disciples

sayings.text: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, while still with them

sayings.text: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Holy Spirit teaching

sayings.text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, his peace

sayings.text: You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on going to the Father

sayings.text: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on telling them beforehand

sayings.text: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the prince of the world

sayings.text: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on rising to go

sayings.text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: But all these things will they do to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the vine discourse

sayings.text: I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on not stumbling

sayings.text: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on persecution

sayings.text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on those who do not know the Father

sayings.text: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on remembering his words

sayings.text: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on going to him who sent him

sayings.text: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on their sorrow

sayings.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Counselor coming

sayings.text: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Spirit convicting the world

sayings.text: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on sin

sayings.text: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on righteousness

sayings.text: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on judgment

sayings.text: I have yet many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on things they cannot bear yet

sayings.text: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Spirit of truth

sayings.text: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Spirit glorifying him

sayings.text: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine, and will declare it to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on what the Father has

sayings.text: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, a little while

sayings.text: Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’
sayings.scene: to the disciples, about their questioning

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on sorrow turned to joy

sayings.text: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, the woman in childbirth

sayings.text: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on their hearts rejoicing

sayings.text: In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on asking the Father in his name

sayings.text: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on asking and receiving

sayings.text: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on figures of speech

sayings.text: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on asking in his name

sayings.text: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on the Father's love

sayings.text: I came from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on coming from the Father

sayings.text: Do you now believe?
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on their believing

sayings.text: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on being scattered

sayings.text: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on peace and overcoming the world

sayings.text: Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you, and they have believed that you sent me.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.
sayings.scene: high-priestly prayer, to the Father

sayings.text: Who are you looking for?
sayings.scene: to the soldiers and officers in the garden

sayings.text: I am he.
sayings.scene: to the soldiers and officers in the garden

sayings.text: Who are you looking for?
sayings.scene: to the soldiers and officers in the garden

sayings.text: I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,
sayings.scene: to the soldiers and officers, protecting his disciples

sayings.text: Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?
sayings.scene: to Peter in the garden

sayings.text: I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
sayings.scene: before Annas the high priest

sayings.text: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said.
sayings.scene: before Annas the high priest

sayings.text: If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?
sayings.scene: to the officer who struck him

sayings.text: Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?
sayings.scene: before Pilate in the Praetorium

sayings.text: My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.
sayings.scene: before Pilate, on his Kingdom

sayings.text: You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.
sayings.scene: before Pilate, on being born to testify to the truth

sayings.text: You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.
sayings.scene: to Pilate, on power given from above

sayings.text: Woman, behold, your son!
sayings.scene: from the cross, to his mother

sayings.text: Behold, your mother!
sayings.scene: from the cross, to the beloved disciple

sayings.text: I am thirsty.
sayings.scene: from the cross, fulfilling Scripture

sayings.text: It is finished.
sayings.scene: from the cross, his final word

sayings.text: Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?
sayings.scene: to Mary Magdalene at the tomb

sayings.text: Mary.
sayings.scene: to Mary Magdalene at the tomb, calling her by name

sayings.text: Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’
sayings.scene: to Mary Magdalene at the tomb

sayings.text: Peace be to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples on Easter evening

sayings.text: Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples on Easter evening, commissioning them

sayings.text: Receive the Holy Spirit!
sayings.scene: to the disciples, breathing on them

sayings.text: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.
sayings.scene: to the disciples, on forgiving and retaining sins

sayings.text: Peace be to you.
sayings.scene: to the disciples eight days later

sayings.text: Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.
sayings.scene: to Thomas, inviting him to touch

sayings.text: Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.
sayings.scene: to Thomas, on believing without seeing

sayings.text: Children, have you anything to eat?
sayings.scene: to the disciples from the shore at Tiberias

sayings.text: Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.
sayings.scene: to the disciples from the shore at Tiberias

sayings.text: Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.
sayings.scene: to the disciples on the beach

sayings.text: Come and eat breakfast.
sayings.scene: to the disciples at the breakfast on the beach

sayings.text: Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter after breakfast on the beach

sayings.text: Feed my lambs.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter after breakfast on the beach

sayings.text: Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter after breakfast on the beach

sayings.text: Tend my sheep.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter after breakfast on the beach

sayings.text: Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter after breakfast on the beach

sayings.text: Feed my sheep.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter after breakfast on the beach

sayings.text: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don’t want to go.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter, foretelling his old age

sayings.text: Follow me.
sayings.scene: to Simon Peter, after the prophecy

sayings.text: If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.
sayings.scene: to Peter, about the beloved disciple
